lines.t:
A type of <c:ffff00>stat<c> for the <c:ffff00>head<c> <c:ffff00>{{part}}<c>.

Measures remaining ammo or energy, that is, how
many times the action can be executed (fired).
It drops each time the {{head_part}}'s <c:ffff00>action<c> is used. At
0 uses, the {{part}} can't be used.
It fully recovers automatically when the <c:ffff00>{{robattle}}<c>
ends.
